reponse: The Nov 12 ingest outage was caused by the disks of Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2 filling up after infra PR #221 removed size-based retention, leaving only 7-day time-based retention; the broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC and consumers stalled [2]. The outage lasted 2h47m (09:38–12:25 UTC), delaying events but losing none [2]. An early hypothesis blamed PR #388's batch size increase, but the revert changed nothing and lag kept growing [1][3], and #388 was later confirmed a red herring and re-applied [5]. Sentry shows the matching KafkaConsumerTimeout from 09:39 to 12:24 UTC [4]. Follow-ups: 80% disk alerting and restoring size-based retention [5].
